title: HP Omnibook X Flip 16" 2K OLED Touch Laptop: Intel Ultra 7 258V CPU, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD $1619.10 Delivered @ HP
body:
Deal: HP Omnibook X Flip 16" 2K OLED Touch Laptop: Intel Ultra 7 258V CPU, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD $1619.10 Delivered @ HP

[mit] I've been out of the loop for years with tech. I need something for some light photo/video editing and gaming. Will this fit the bill or is there something else I should be looking at? I don't really need the 2 in 1 though.
[Jazza2400] This has decent specs, the processor has ARC Graphics which you can lookup (link below) and see if it fits what you are after. However the 258V gives up some performance for battery life. You might find something slightly cheaper on clearance. Really depends on gaming, if you are happy with 30-60fps on low settings it'll fit the bill.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JWati8uuyG4
[mit] Thanks. It's just cs and dota. Nothing crazy.
[iSmart] Depends what you mean by gaming.
This won't do modern AAA but can do 2000s AAA with its integrated Intel Inside GraFX.
… Think OG Deux Ex, KOTOR, Dragon Age Origins.
[encryptededdy] HP specs on the page say this is a 62.5% sRGB display (I think OLED in the title is wrong), so I would say no for photo editing. The colour gamut is very poor.
[icarus255] I bought the 288V version of the deal below. Similar specs but much better battery life. It's ok for some light-medium gaming. I mainly play turn based strategy on it so lag and fps is not really that important to me. Anything AAA I play on my desktop.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/911351
[VluHunt8r] Check and make sure you like the keyboard before buying! This laptop uses larger keycaps that sit flush against each other without traditional island-style gaps.
[Nom] You can get used to any keyboard just fine, but it takes a few days. On the plus side, it will only annoy you for the first few days.
[niftythrift] Can this be used for digital art, with a pen?
[SpaceJudge] This sent me down a rabbit hole, seems good specs but reviews put me off and now I am looking at other laptops….. Any tips Ozbargin brains trust?
[MadoxNet] Can you link me to a couple of those reviews please?
[Birdseye] Correct me if I'm wrong, but wasn't a 3k version of this same laptop on sale for $5 cheaper up until a couple of days ago?
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/970599
[chutibuti] yes , resolution of this : WUXGA / 2K (1920 x 1200) vs deal on the other day 3K (2880 x 1800),
[Birdseye] Yeah thought so. I was tempted by the other one but would wait for a better deal than this one
